# Test Dashboard

```{shinylive-r}
#| standalone: true
#| viewerHeight: 600

library(shiny)

ui <- fluidPage(
  h1("Hello Shinylive!"),
  sliderInput("n", "N:", 1, 100, 50),
  plotOutput("plot")
)

server <- function(input, output) {
  output$plot <- renderPlot({
    hist(rnorm(input$n))
  })
}

shinyApp(ui, server)
```
